description: Screening ideal-gas E -> S + H2 equilibrium for planning a cofeed gate; not a certified thermochemical evaluation.

styrene.selection: Prosen and Rossini 1945 formation enthalpy; Pitzer 1946 entropy as compiled; TRC 1997 recommended gas Cp. Discrepant historical formation enthalpies are not averaged.

limits: Reuse ethylbenzene and hydrogen evaluation choices and integration method from the base calculation.
Treat tabulated reference entropies as 1 bar for screening; an unresolved 1 atm versus 1 bar convention contributes a small additional systematic uncertainty.
Cp uncertainty and covariance of formation values are not available. Reported input errors do not define a complete confidence interval.
The plus/minus 5 kJ/mol perturbation is a sensitivity scenario, not an estimated error or confidence interval.
Equilibrium boundaries do not predict kinetics, cleaning, selectivity, attainable conversion, or separation cost.
